Cut: Pompadour with High or Skin Fade
What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: Vertical volume concentrates the eye high above the forehead against the cheek width; the skin-faded sides remove the horizontal bulk that typically makes a face look wider (lovelyish.com); the mound balances a chubby face and a double chin (lovelyish.com)
Sides & Nape: Sides shaved down to the skin in the high-fade version (lovelyish.com); short or faded sides in the classic version kept sharp with regular trims (favoritehairstyles.com); the clean fade removes width while the lifted top draws attention upward (barbermodel.com)
Top Length & Layering: Top swept up and back (favoritehairstyles.com); matte pomade for a natural finish on straight or slightly wavy hair (favoritehairstyles.com); strong-hold pomade or gel to hold the shape (barbermodel.com); works best on thick or medium hair blow-dried upward before styling (writeforusfashion.co.uk)
Fringe or Beard Pairing: No fringe on this build; the beard does the framing - a trimmed beard can provide a shape to the jaw and create structure (favoritehairstyles.com); a neatly trimmed beard can very effectively highlight the jawline (toniandguysalon.in)

What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: The textured quiff remains a gold standard for men wanting to slim down a rounder facial profile - brushing up and slightly back adds significant vertical height that draws the eye away from the width of the cheeks (lovelyish.com)
Sides & Nape: Works best when the sides are kept short or faded to create a clear distinction between the face and the hair (lovelyish.com); stylexmagazine.com runs its quiff on a mid fade
Top Length & Layering: Volume on the front and top elongating the face shape; professional combed-up or casually disheveled (favoritehairstyles.com); matte pomade or styling powder holds the lived-in texture through the day (lovelyish.com); medium hair straight or wavy (favoritehairstyles.com)
Fringe or Beard Pairing: No fringe; goatee listed as the pairing option for chubby men's cuts (hairstylecamp.com; writeforusfashion.co.uk)

What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: The rough top gives depth and motion so the hair does not appear flat while the faded sides make the entire appearance clean and slim (favoritehairstyles.com)
Sides & Nape: Faded sides (favoritehairstyles.com); the high-fade build: textured crop high fade point-cut top matte finish (stylexmagazine.com); the fade line softens around week 3 to 4 (stylexmagazine.com)
Top Length & Layering: Suits thick or slightly curly hair styled with little product (favoritehairstyles.com); skip the gel - matte clay only worked upward (stylexmagazine.com)
Fringe or Beard Pairing: The crop's own front rule: short broken pieces never one heavy straight line across the forehead; a beard or stubble significantly enhances the haircut's shape when trimmed well (newlooksdaily.com)

What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: Closely cropped back and sides with a somewhat longer top read neat; the minimal length contributes to the delicate look thus making the face appear slimmer (newlooksdaily.com)
Sides & Nape: Closely cropped back and sides (newlooksdaily.com); cut on a mid fade - barber request: crew cut 1.5 to 2 inches mid fade I'll style it upward not flat (stylexmagazine.com)
Top Length & Layering: 1.5 to 2 inches on top (stylexmagazine.com) - 1.5 x 2.54 = 3.8 cm and 2 x 2.54 = 5.1 cm arithmetic on the fixed definition of an inch; styled upward never flattened
Fringe or Beard Pairing: No fringe; crew cut or buzz cut with beard both require very little help from the stylist (toniandguysalon.in)

What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: The progressive erosion makes the sides sharp and the top is voluminous and contributes to the height - a crisp well-cut look (favoritehairstyles.com)
Sides & Nape: The taper itself: sides faded or tapered to make the face narrower (favoritehairstyles.com maintenance list); wearable at all ages casual through formal (favoritehairstyles.com)
Top Length & Layering: Voluminous top carrying the height; the style is fresh and stylish with regular trims (favoritehairstyles.com)
Fringe or Beard Pairing: No fringe; beard grooming so that you can sharpen your jawline sits in the same guide's maintenance list (favoritehairstyles.com)

What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: A sectioned fade is ideal for balancing a chubby face - the hollow gives the face an unbalanced look making it look thinner (favoritehairstyles.com)
Sides & Nape: The fade with the hollow at the side; professional enough for office wear (favoritehairstyles.com)
Top Length & Layering: A slimmer top worn sleek or slightly textured (favoritehairstyles.com); stylexmagazine.com runs the style as side part with volume blowing the part up rather than flat; suits a majority of hair types simple to maintain through frequent barber visits (favoritehairstyles.com)
Fringe or Beard Pairing: No fringe - the part is the front; goatee listed as the beard pairing (hairstylecamp.com)

What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: Very short or bald sides against a longer top produce a sharp contrast; the attention on the top contributes to height (favoritehairstyles.com)
Sides & Nape: Very short or bald sides (favoritehairstyles.com); short disconnected sides textured finish (stylexmagazine.com)
Top Length & Layering: Three inches minimum on top (stylexmagazine.com) - 3 x 2.54 = 7.6 cm arithmetic; the top can be slicked back textured or pushed to the side and the cut is ideal for thick hair (favoritehairstyles.com)

What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: The centre-arranged vertical accent creates less emphasis on the cheeks (favoritehairstyles.com); a bold option for men who want the height concentrated in one strip
Sides & Nape: Sides clipped or faded (favoritehairstyles.com); barber request: faux hawk center volume high fade on the sides (stylexmagazine.com)
Top Length & Layering: Short to medium hair; done using wax or clay to give it a textured look (favoritehairstyles.com)
Fringe or Beard Pairing: No fringe; barbermodel.com files the faux hawk under Longer Look with the avoid column reading Bowl Cut Flat Top

What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: Curls concentrated on top with the sides tight keep the volume off the cheeks - curly with side tight (idntimes.com); for long curly hair shaving the sides is a dramatic and eye-catching style (hairstylecamp.com)
Sides & Nape: Sides shaved (hairstylecamp.com) or made thinner - side and back taken down finer than the top (idntimes.com)
Top Length & Layering: Long curls left on top to carry the height (hairstylecamp.com); styled with gel or wax worked through with the fingers (idntimes.com)
Fringe or Beard Pairing: No fringe; a beard kept trimmed improves the outline (newlooksdaily.com); barbermodel.com's avoid column flags the Full Afro for its balanced-shape row - the warning is about total width not curls on top

Cut: Buzz Cut with Beard (the disputed row)
What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: The guides split three ways on this cut all three stated: favoritehairstyles.com's FAQ holds buzz cuts are not recommended for chubby faces; newlooksdaily.com lists the buzz cut among its best 8 short haircuts for men with chubby faces; toniandguysalon.in runs buzz cut and beard as one of its 10 calling it contrast-and-balance drawing that requires very little help from the stylist. Same clipper three verdicts - settle it against your own head
Sides & Nape: Uniform clipper length all over by definition; toniandguysalon.in frames the contrast work as the beard's job not the fade's
Top Length & Layering: No guide in the set states a guard number for the chubby-male buzz - none is supplied here either
Fringe or Beard Pairing: The beard is the whole pro case: a neatly trimmed beard can very effectively highlight the jawline and balance the facial features (toniandguysalon.in); beard and stubble enhance the cut's shape when trimmed well (newlooksdaily.com); on the con side favoritehairstyles.com's FAQ steers toward short hairstyles in the form of texture and volume instead

What It Does for a Fuller Male Face: The dispute runs on flatness both sides carried: stylexmagazine.com warns a flat slick back removes all vertical volume and does the opposite of what a round face needs; lovelyish.com holds the lifted version - round-brush volume at the roots before sweeping back - actually quite flattering for fuller faces exposing the forehead and elongating the whole frame; favoritehairstyles.com files the slicked-back as a timeless style that helps the longer-face appearance. The lifted read and the flat warning are not the same haircut
Sides & Nape: Tapered sides keep the profile slim (lovelyish.com); sides trimmed to keep the face structured and defined (favoritehairstyles.com)
Top Length & Layering: 4 inches on top with root lift (stylexmagazine.com) - 4 x 2.54 = 10.2 cm arithmetic; best with long or medium hair held in place by a light pomade or gel (favoritehairstyles.com); blow-dried back and up while damp (stylexmagazine.com)
Fringe or Beard Pairing: No fringe - the exposed forehead is the point; optional beard to sharpen the jawline (favoritehairstyles.com)
